sourceLabel: 26 石雷鹏大作文笔记 - 英语一（整理自：学长小谭）
scope: 图画作文（图画类大作文）

pages.title: 第三章 图画作文 · 审题三事项与写作思路
pageNotes: 审题：题目读三遍，否则不动笔
a.英文指令
b.图画信息（环境＋相关人＋物＋动作）
c.文字说明
如何避免跑题：图画信息与文字说明相结合（简单清晰的汉语思路＋正确高端的英文表达）
筛选标准：不是所有图画细节都需要描写，应选择与文字说明呼应的核心元素
验证方法：通过文字说明反向验证图画解读的合理性
典型错误：将辅助性细节（如人物动作、背景元素）误认为主要描写对象
错误示例与正确方向对照：龙舟比赛场景写防溺水（仅看图不看文字）→「龙舟比赛」指向传统文化主题；围观人群写防踩踏事故（脱离主题）→「咱们村」可延伸乡村发展话题；老人牵手写黄昏恋（过度解读细节）→「越来越热闹」可写文化振兴或生活改善
图画作文思路 · 首段：描述图画/图表；文字材料概述。适配原则：根据考题类型灵活选择描述对象；核心要求：保持客观描述，避免在首段加入主观分析
图画作文思路 · 中间段：现象+特征+原因+意义+比喻+危害+对比+观点…（首/尾段选写）。灵活组合：各维度可单独使用也可混合使用；布局自由：分析维度之间没有固定顺序要求；跨段分配：部分内容可酌情分配至首段或尾段
图画作文思路 · 尾段：建议+展望+号召
大作文与小作文的功能句通用性 · 阅卷机制：大/小作文由不同老师批阅，功能句可安全复用；实践建议：建立通用功能句库，灵活应用于各类作文题型

pages.title: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 六大语法现象与首段描述

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 首句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·引入句（可省）
entries.originalText: These are two simple but enlightening drawings.
entries.en: These are two simple but enlightening {图画载体}.
entries.zh: 这是两幅简单但有启发性的{图画载体}。
notes: 首句：引入图画（可省）
两幅图用 These are two...，单幅图改为 This is a...

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 图画描述主句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·图画描述（环境+人/物+动作+文字）
entries.originalText: Inside a huge warm house, there is a little and delicate flower, growing vigorously and blossoming, with the house protecting it from the outside severe weather.
entries.en: Inside {环境}, there is {主体}, {伴随动作}, with {周围事物} {周围事物状态}.
entries.zh: 在{环境}中，有{主体}，{伴随动作}，{周围事物}{周围事物状态}。

examples.label: 03 年英语一真题（温室花朵）
examples.en: Inside a huge warm house, there is a little and delicate flower, growing vigorously and blossoming, with the house protecting it from the outside severe weather.
examples.zh: 在一个巨大的温室中，有一个小而精致的花朵，在茁壮成长中开花，周围的房子保护着它免受外部的暴风雨。

notes: 图画描述公式：环境+人/物+动作+文字
语法现象1：介词短语表环境
语法现象2：There be 句式引出相关的人和物
语法现象3：人和物之后使用 v-ing 形式/v-ed 表伴随的动作；v-ing 表主动，v-ed 表被动
语法现象4：with+名词+v-ing/v-ed/介词/形容词短语 → 表身上或周围的事物

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 让步反差句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·让步反差句（表前后对比）
entries.originalText: Although it seems quite healthy and strong in the house, this plant withers quickly after it is put in the rain, with its petals falling in the wind.
entries.en: Although {主体} seems {正面状态} in {原环境}, {主体} {负面变化} after it is put in {新环境}, with {伴随细节}.
entries.zh: 尽管{主体}在{原环境}中看起来{正面状态}，但当它被放置在{新环境}之后，很快就{负面变化}，{伴随细节}。
notes: 语法现象5：although 引导让步状语，表反差
两幅对比图必用此句式，把前后变化压缩在一句里

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 文字说明句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·文字说明句（被动句+定语从句）
entries.originalText: Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say/read that flowers in the greenhouse cannot stand (withstand/ bear/ tolerate/ survive) the wind and rain.
entries.en: Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say that {文字说明内容}.
entries.zh: 最后，若干汉字能被注意到，其内容是{文字说明内容}。

examples.label: 03 年英语一真题（温室花朵）
examples.en: several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say that flowers in the greenhouse cannot stand the wind and rain
examples.zh: 若干汉字能被注意到，其内容是「温室的花朵经不起风雨」

notes: 语法现象6：被动句+定从，专门用于翻译图画里的文字说明
这一句是图画作文的得分要点，必须写，因为文字说明决定全文立意

pageNotes: 审题要点 · 现实寓意：温室→父母的过度保护；花朵→被溺爱的孩子；风雨→社会现实的挑战
错误立意警示：避免写成「农民生活悲惨」或「花熟了可以吃」等偏离主题的理解；必须紧扣文字说明「温室花朵经不起风雨」展开

pages.title: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 主体段与尾段骨架

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第二段联系现实句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·联系现实句（图画→现实的桥梁）
entries.originalText: The contemporary Chinese families are characterized by "one family, one child", and such a scene/scenario above can be associated (related/ linked/connected) with a host of parents and their kids in reality.
entries.en: {背景主体} are characterized by {突出特征}, and such a scene above can be associated with a host of {现实对应群体} in reality.
entries.zh: {背景主体}的突出特征就在于{突出特征}。因此，上述场景就能自然而然地让我们联想到现实生活中的很多{现实对应群体}。
notes: 这是图画作文第二段的必写句：把图画场景与现实现象挂钩
a host of 意为「很多」，比 many 高级

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第二段现象描述句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象描述句（诚然让步）
entries.originalText: Admittedly, an increasing number of parents, now, prepare almost everything for their children, such as foods, clothes, houses, tuition, marriage and even future jobs.
entries.en: Admittedly, an increasing number of {现实群体}, now, {现象行为}, such as {列举一}, {列举二} and even {列举三}.
entries.zh: 诚然，如今越来越多{现实群体}{现象行为}，例如{列举一}、{列举二}甚至{列举三}。
notes: now 作插入语，用逗号隔开
such as 后列举三项，用「A, B and even C」递进

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第二段现象评价句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象评价句（值得关注＋原因）
entries.originalText: This phenomenon is particularly worth concerning for the reason that(because) fathers and mothers focus only on youngsters' comfort and enjoyment, ignoring (=neglecting) the significance of independence for the young.
entries.en: This phenomenon is particularly worth concerning for the reason that {主体} focus only on {片面关注对象}, ignoring the significance of {被忽略的重要事物}.
entries.zh: 这种现象很值得关注，原因是{主体}极为关注{片面关注对象}，忽略了{被忽略的重要事物}的重要性。
notes: 「focus only on A, ignoring B」是石雷鹏体系的核心批判句式：只顾 A 忽略 B
ignoring 为现在分词作伴随状语

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第二段强调句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·根源强调句（It is...that...）
entries.originalText: It is parents' overprotection that causes/enables young people to build up inadequate competence or confidence to face the society.
entries.en: It is {根本原因} that causes {受影响群体} to {产生的后果}.
entries.zh: 正是{根本原因}使得{受影响群体}{产生的后果}。
notes: It is…that… 强调句式，用于点明根本原因，是拉分句型

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第三段比喻句
entries.section: 图画作文第三段·比喻句（can be likened to）
entries.originalText: However, independence, to my understanding, can be likened to a journey leading to (=which/that leads to) success.
entries.en: However, {核心品质}, to my understanding, can be likened to {比喻对象} leading to {比喻结果}.
entries.zh: 然而，在我看来，{核心品质}能够被比喻成一条通向{比喻结果}的{比喻对象}。
notes: can be likened to 是图画作文的高分比喻句式，图画类题目几乎都能用
leading to 为现在分词短语作后置定语，等于 which/that leads to

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第三段意义三益处句
entries.section: 图画作文第三段·意义句（三益处并列）
entries.originalText: As a significant quality, independence may bring teenagers power, arouse their enthusiasm for life and help them win in the future social competition.
entries.en: As a significant quality, {核心品质} may bring {受益群体} {益处一}, arouse their {益处二} and help them {益处三}.
entries.zh: 作为一种重要的素质，{核心品质}会带给{受益群体}{益处一}，唤起他们{益处二}，帮助他们{益处三}。
notes: bring / arouse / help 三个动词并列共享主语，是石雷鹏体系最高频的「三益处」结构
该结构在小作文里同样可用（大小作文功能句通用）

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 第三段危害句
entries.section: 图画作文第三段·危害句（构成障碍）
entries.originalText: Unfortunately, some parents' too much love, like the greenhouse, has constituted an obstacle that hinders their children's growth.
entries.en: Unfortunately, {负面因素}, like {图画意象}, has constituted an obstacle that hinders {受害对象}.
entries.zh: 不幸的是，就像{图画意象}一样，{负面因素}已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着{受害对象}。
notes: like + 图画意象 是回扣图画的技巧，让论述与首段描述形成呼应
constitute an obstacle that hinders 是固定危害句式

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 尾段社会建议句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·社会层面建议句
entries.originalText: Hence, the society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to criticize parents' blind love.
entries.en: Hence, the society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to {社会行动}.
entries.zh: 因此，整个社会应该营造一个积极的氛围，去{社会行动}。
notes: 尾段第一层：社会层面。foster a positive atmosphere 是通用建议句式，正面题用 advocate/promote，负面题用 criticize/refuse

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 尾段个人建议句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·个人层面建议句
entries.originalText: Furthermore, it is advisable for parents to offer their kids freedom and opportunities to grow independently.
entries.en: Furthermore, it is advisable for {行动主体} to {具体建议}.
entries.zh: 而且，{行动主体}应该{具体建议}。
notes: 尾段第二层：具体主体层面，与社会层面形成「宏观→微观」递进

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 尾段总结句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·总结句（牢记型）
entries.originalText: To conclude, all parents should bear in mind that they cannot protect their kids for a lifetime.
entries.en: To conclude, {对象} should bear in mind that {应牢记的道理}.
entries.zh: 总之，{对象}都应该牢记：{应牢记的道理}。
notes: bear in mind that 后接从句，用于收束全文的道理性总结

vocab.en: in reality = in the real life
to my understanding = in my opinion = from my perspective

pages.title: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 双图描述与批判骨架

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 首句（讽刺类）
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·引入句（讽刺类双图）
entries.originalText: These/Given are two simple but ridiculous (satirical/ironic/sarcastic) photos.
entries.en: These are two simple but ridiculous {图画载体}.
entries.zh: 这些是两幅简单但具有讽刺性的{图画载体}。
notes: 负面讽刺类图画专用引入句，与正面启发类的 enlightening 相对

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 左图描述
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·左图描述（with 结构表身上事物）
entries.originalText: In the left one/photo, there is a youngster with the name "Beckham"(written)on his face(cheek).
entries.en: In the left photo, there is {主体} with {身上事物} on {部位}.
entries.zh: 在左边的照片中，有{主体}，{部位}上有{身上事物}。
notes: 双图题按「In the left photo... / In the right photo...」分述
with + 名词 + 介词短语，表身上的事物

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 右图描述
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·右图描述（v-ing 表伴随动作）
entries.originalText: Similarly, the young guy in the right photo sits in a barber's shop, spending 300 yuan in designing (to design) his hairstyle as cool(fashionable) as Beckham's.
entries.en: Similarly, {主体} in the right photo {主要动作}, {伴随动作} as {比较对象} as {参照对象}.
entries.zh: 相类似地，右图中的{主体}{主要动作}，{伴随动作}，与{参照对象}一样{比较对象}。
notes: Similarly 连接第二幅图，避免两句都用 In the...photo
as...as... 同级比较结构

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 第二段联系现实句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·联系现实句（人物特征型）
entries.originalText: These two young men are characterized by/featured with their crazy/feverish love for Beckham and we can associate such a scenario with a host of passionate/enthusiastic fans of stars in reality.
entries.en: These two {图中人物} are characterized by {人物特征}, and we can associate such a scenario with a host of {现实对应群体} in reality.
entries.zh: 这两个{图中人物}的突出特征就在于{人物特征}，而且我们能把这种场景联系到现实中很多{现实对应群体}。
notes: 以图中人物的特征为切入点联系现实，适用于人物类图画

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 第二段现象描述句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象描述句（着迷型）
entries.originalText: Admittedly/Definitely, an increasing number of teenagers now, are fascinated/attracted with various celebrities, such as world champions, pop singers, renowned actors and so forth.
entries.en: Admittedly, an increasing number of {现实群体} now, are fascinated with various {对象}, such as {列举一}, {列举二}, {列举三} and so forth.
entries.zh: 不得不承认，越来越多{现实群体}，如今，对各种{对象}很着迷，例如{列举一}、{列举二}、{列举三}等。
notes: and so forth 等于 and so on，用于开放式列举

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 第二段现象评价句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象评价句（只关注表面型）
entries.originalText: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that some of them focus merely on stars' superficial lifestyles, ignoring/overlooking the significance of learning their merits/strong points/virtues or excellent qualities.
entries.en: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that some of them focus merely on {表面事物}, ignoring the significance of {真正重要的事物}.
entries.zh: 这种现象是很值得关注的，因为他们之中的一些人只关注{表面事物}，无视{真正重要的事物}的重要性。
notes: superficial 表「肤浅的」，是批判类高频词

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 第二段危害句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·危害句（盲目行为型）
entries.originalText: Unfortunately, this sort of blind worship may constituted an obstacle that will hinder their long-term growth and progress.
entries.en: Unfortunately, this sort of {负面行为} may constitute an obstacle that will hinder {受害对象}.
entries.zh: 不幸的是，这种{负面行为}可能会构成一种障碍，将阻碍{受害对象}。
notes: 原文 may constituted 为笔记笔误，规范用法应为 may constitute

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 第二段正面建议句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·正面转折建议句（三益处）
entries.originalText: As a matter of fact, it is advisable for us to learn from positive examples, which can bring us right directions, arouse/inspire our passion for striving and help us enhance ourselves.
entries.en: As a matter of fact, it is advisable for us to {正面行为}, which can bring us {益处一}, arouse our {益处二} and help us {益处三}.
entries.zh: 事实上，我们应该{正面行为}，这会带给我们{益处一}，会唤起我们{益处二}，会帮助我们{益处三}。
notes: 批判之后给正面出路，形成「否定—肯定」结构
again 使用 bring/arouse/help 三益处并列

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 尾段比喻句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·比喻句（光明意象型）
entries.originalText: To my understanding, a positive idol can be likened to light in the dark, directing/guiding us to a promising future.
entries.en: To my understanding, {核心事物} can be likened to {比喻意象}, guiding us to {美好结果}.
entries.zh: 在我看来，{核心事物}能被比喻成{比喻意象}，引领我们走向{美好结果}。
notes: 比喻句可置于第二段也可置于尾段，位置灵活

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 尾段号召句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·号召句（学习美德型）
entries.originalText: Accordingly, as youngsters, we are supposed to have our own idols, and it is exceedingly necessary for us to learn their virtues or merits, such as diligence, perseverance/persistence, confidence and optimism.
entries.en: Accordingly, as {自身身份}, we are supposed to {行动一}, and it is exceedingly necessary for us to {行动二}, such as {列举一}, {列举二} and {列举三}.
entries.zh: 因此，我们作为{自身身份}，应该{行动一}，而且我们很有必要去{行动二}，例如{列举一}、{列举二}、{列举三}。
notes: 品质类列举高频词：diligence（勤奋）、perseverance（坚持）、confidence（自信）、optimism（乐观）

entries.origin: 实训1：偶像崇拜（06 年）· 参考范文尾句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·收尾句（以此方式型）
entries.originalText: In this manner, we can better ourselves.
entries.en: In this manner, we can {最终收获}.
entries.zh: 以这种方式，我们才能{最终收获}。
notes: 短句收尾，全文 173 words
better 在此作动词，意为「改善」

pages.title: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 单图描述与举例论证

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 首段文字说明先行句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·文字说明先行句（先点题再描述）
entries.originalText: First of all, several Chinese characters interpret the implied meaning of this drawing: an end means another new begin. Then, let us closely observe the drawing.
entries.en: First of all, several Chinese characters interpret the implied meaning of this drawing: {文字说明内容}. Then, let us closely observe the drawing.
entries.zh: 首先，几个汉字阐述了图画的寓意：{文字说明内容}。接下来，让我们仔细观察一下图片吧！
notes: 与精讲1 相反的写法：先写文字说明点明立意，再描述画面
let us closely observe 是过渡到画面描述的自然衔接

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 单图描述句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·单图描述（环境+人+动作+表情）
entries.originalText: On a running track, there is a confident athlete, dashing to the end of a race, with an optimistic smile on his face.
entries.en: On {环境}, there is {主体}, {伴随动作}, with {表情或身上细节} on his face.
entries.zh: 在{环境}上，有{主体}，{伴随动作}，脸上洋溢着{表情或身上细节}。
notes: 「介词短语表环境 + there be + v-ing 伴随 + with 表情」四要素齐全，是单图描述的标准模板

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 让步转折句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·让步转折句（尽管…立即…）
entries.originalText: Although he is rather exhausted, the guy starts his next pursuit immediately.
entries.en: Although {主体} is rather {当前状态}, {主体} {后续行动} immediately.
entries.zh: 尽管{主体}已经很{当前状态}，但他还是立即{后续行动}。
notes: 用于正面励志类图画，突出主体的坚持精神

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 第二段联系现实句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·联系现实句（场景型简洁版）
entries.originalText: Such a scene above can be associated with a host of successful individuals in reality. They achieve success in their fields, but they are not proud or satisfied. Instead, they set for bigger targets at once.
entries.en: Such a scene above can be associated with a host of {现实对应群体} in reality. They {正面行为一}, but they are not {负面状态}. Instead, they {正面行为二}.
entries.zh: 上述场景能自然使我们联系到现实生活中很多{现实对应群体}。他们{正面行为一}，并未{负面状态}。相反，他们{正面行为二}。
notes: Instead 引导转折，形成「不是…而是…」的对比论证

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 第二段美德赞扬句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·美德赞扬句（值得赞扬＋强调句）
entries.originalText: This virtue is particularly worth praising for the reason that it is their perseverance that enables them to succeed again and again.
entries.en: This virtue is particularly worth praising for the reason that it is their {核心品质} that enables them to {正面结果}.
entries.zh: 这种美德值得赞扬，因为正是他们的{核心品质}使得他们{正面结果}。
notes: 正面题用 worth praising，负面题用 worth concerning，两者结构完全一致
内嵌 it is...that... 强调句

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 第三段比喻＋举例句
entries.section: 图画作文第三段·比喻＋名人举例（A case in point）
entries.originalText: Life, to my understanding, can be likened to a road with no everlasting success. A case in point is Yao Ming, who has been a renowned basketball player. After his retirement, he continued to strive and created his own business. Actually, there are so many celebrities like Yao.
entries.en: {核心事物}, to my understanding, can be likened to {比喻意象}. A case in point is {举例人物}, who has been {人物身份}. After {转折时点}, he continued to {后续行动}. Actually, there are so many {同类群体} like {举例人物}.
entries.zh: 在我看来，{核心事物}能够被比喻成{比喻意象}。一个典型例子就是曾经身为{人物身份}的{举例人物}。{转折时点}后，他继续{后续行动}。事实上，像{举例人物}这样的{同类群体}很多很多。

examples.label: 04 年英语一真题（终点又是起点）
examples.en: A case in point is Yao Ming, who has been a renowned basketball player. After his retirement, he continued to strive and created his own business.
examples.zh: 一个典型例子就是曾经身为著名篮球运动员的姚明。退役后，他继续奋斗并创建了自己的公司。

notes: 题目要求 support your view with examples 时必须举例
举名人事例的三步：who 引出身份 → After 转折 → 后续行动

entries.origin: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 尾段道理＋双主体建议
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·道理句＋社会与个人双建议
entries.originalText: Everyone should bear in mind that any success is temporary. Accordingly, the society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to refuse or criticize the satisfaction for small success. Meanwhile, it is advisable for us, as youngsters, to enhance ourselves by continually striving for bigger targets.
entries.en: Everyone should bear in mind that {应牢记的道理}. Accordingly, the society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to {社会行动}. Meanwhile, it is advisable for us, as {自身身份}, to {个人行动}.
entries.zh: 每个人都应该牢记：{应牢记的道理}。因此，整个社会应该营造积极氛围，去{社会行动}。同时，作为{自身身份}的我们应该{个人行动}。
notes: 尾段三层结构：道理句 → 社会层面 → 个人层面，全文 221 words
这是图画作文最完整的尾段模板

pageNotes: 解读误区 · 正确主题：「终点又是新起点」的核心寓意
典型误读：环境主题（将低矮树木误读为环境恶化）、残疾解读（将跑步单腿着地误认为残疾）、过度引申（苍蝇等细节不应过度解读）
判断标准：漫画反映普遍生活哲理，非特殊社会问题

pages.title: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 双刃剑辩证骨架

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 文字说明句（矛盾型）
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·文字说明句（矛盾并列型）
entries.originalText: Several/Some/Certain Chinese characters, finally, can be noticed, which read/say that the online/Internet distance is "near" as well as "far".
entries.en: Several Chinese characters, finally, can be noticed, which read that {矛盾概念A} is "{矛盾词一}" as well as "{矛盾词二}".
entries.zh: 最后，若干汉字能被注意到，其内容是，{矛盾概念A}既是「{矛盾词一}」也是「{矛盾词二}」。
notes: A as well as B 用于并列矛盾的两个概念，适合辩证类图画
finally 作插入语置于主语后

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 参考范文首段描述
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·群体场景描述（多人同一动作）
entries.originalText: Inside a huge spider-net, there are hundreds of individuals at different ages, sitting in front of computers and surfing the Internet. Although they are quite near, these web surfers never chat face to face.
entries.en: Inside {环境}, there are hundreds of {主体群体} at different ages, {伴随动作一} and {伴随动作二}. Although they are quite {表面状态}, these {主体群体} never {缺失行为}.
entries.zh: 在{环境}里，有着不同年龄段的很多{主体群体}，他们{伴随动作一}并{伴随动作二}。尽管他们很{表面状态}，但这些{主体群体}几乎没有{缺失行为}。
notes: 多人场景用 there are hundreds of，并用 at different ages 增加细节
「Although 表面近 + 实际远」正是本题立意所在

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 第二段现象描述句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象描述句（耗时行为型）
entries.originalText: Admittedly/Undoubtedly, an increasing number of individuals/a growing number of people now, spend too much time on the Internet to chat with others, browse/see/read news or watch videos.
entries.en: Admittedly, an increasing number of {现实群体} now, spend too much time on {耗时对象} to {行为一}, {行为二} or {行为三}.
entries.zh: 不得不承认，越来越多{现实群体}，如今，每天花费太多时间在{耗时对象}上去{行为一}、{行为二}或{行为三}。
notes: 写作思路提示：不必局限于批判年轻人，可改为 people 或 netizens 扩大论述范围
上网活动可具体化为 chatting, playing games, watching videos 等多样化表达

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 第二段现象评价句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象评价句（沉溺忽视型）
entries.originalText: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that these people may be addicted to/indulge themselves in the virtual world, ignoring their friends and family members in reality.
entries.en: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that these people may be addicted to {沉溺对象}, ignoring {被忽略对象} in reality.
entries.zh: 这种现象非常值得关注，因为这些人可能沉溺于{沉溺对象}，忽略了现实生活中的{被忽略对象}。
notes: be addicted to / indulge oneself in 是沉溺类批判的两个标准表达

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 第二段双重强调句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·双重强调句（正反同源）
entries.originalText: It is the Internet that shortens the distance, but it is (also) the Internet that causes the interpersonal relation(ship) to become indifferent/cold or "far".
entries.en: It is {核心事物} that {正面作用}, but it is also {核心事物} that causes {受影响对象} to become {负面结果}.
entries.zh: 正是{核心事物}{正面作用}，但也正是{核心事物}导致{受影响对象}变得{负面结果}。
notes: 两个 It is...that... 强调句并列，突出同一事物的正反两面，是辩证类图画的核心拉分句
负面效应可用 indifference in real-life relationships 表达人际疏远

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 第二段双刃剑比喻
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·双刃剑比喻句（辩证总起）
entries.originalText: Thus, the Internet, to my understanding, can be likened to a double-edged sword.
entries.en: Thus, {核心事物}, to my understanding, can be likened to a double-edged sword.
entries.zh: 因此，在我看来，{核心事物}能被比喻成一把双刃剑。
notes: double-edged sword 是辩证类题目的万能比喻，后接 On the one hand / On the other hand 展开

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 第二段正面展开
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·双刃剑正面（On the one hand）
entries.originalText: On the one hand, it can bring us tremendous convenience, and help us remove/get rid of =eliminate the barrier in distance.
entries.en: On the one hand, it can bring us {正面益处}, and help us remove {被消除的障碍}.
entries.zh: 一方面，它能带给我们{正面益处}，帮我们消除了{被消除的障碍}。

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 第二段负面展开
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·双刃剑负面（On the other hand）
entries.originalText: On the other hand, the Internet has constituted an obstacle that hinders humans' normal communication.
entries.en: On the other hand, {核心事物} has constituted an obstacle that hinders {受害对象}.
entries.zh: 另一方面，{核心事物}已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着{受害对象}。
notes: 与 On the one hand 严格对应，两句必须成对出现

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 尾段理性使用建议
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·理性使用建议句
entries.originalText: In a nutshell, as a youngster, I am convinced that it is advisable for us to use/utilize the Internet in a rational/sensible=appropriately manner.
entries.en: In a nutshell, as {自身身份}, I am convinced that it is advisable for us to {建议行为} in a rational manner.
entries.zh: 总之，作为{自身身份}，我认为我们应该以理性的方式来{建议行为}。
notes: I am convinced that 比 I think 高级，表示「我确信」

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 尾段牢记句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·牢记句（工具论）
entries.originalText: So, we are well-advised to bear in mind that the Internet is just/only/ merely a tool.
entries.en: So, we are well-advised to bear in mind that {核心事物} is merely {本质定位}.
entries.zh: 此外，我们应该牢记，{核心事物}只是{本质定位}。

entries.origin: 实训2：网络的近与远（09 年）· 尾段倒装警示句
entries.section: 图画作文尾段·倒装警示句（never 提前）
entries.originalText: We can never ... =Never can we become slaves to/of any scientific product, including the Internet and cell phones.
entries.en: Never can we become slaves of any {负面对象}, including {列举一} and {列举二}.
entries.zh: 我们不能变成包括{列举一}、{列举二}在内的任何{负面对象}的奴隶。
notes: 语法点：Never 置于句首引起部分倒装，助动词提前，是高分句式
原句 We can never... 改写为 Never can we... 即得倒装

pageNotes: 现象描述：人们花费大量时间在网络世界
现象表达：不得不承认，越来越多的人如今每天花费太多时间在网上聊天、浏览新闻或看视频
现象评价：这种现象非常值得关注，因为人们可能沉溺于虚拟世界（be addicted to/indulge in），忽略了现实生活中的家人和朋友
写作思路 · 对象调整：不必局限于批判年轻人，可改为 people 或 netizens 扩大论述范围
写作思路 · 行为列举：上网活动可具体化为 chatting, playing games, watching videos 等多样化表达
写作思路 · 负面效应：强调网络导致人际关系疏远（indifference in real-life relationships）

pages.title: 13 年英语一：选择 · 岔路口类图画与职业词汇

entries.origin: 13 年英语一：选择 · 首段文字说明句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·文字说明句（精确字数型）
entries.originalText: To begin with/First of all/Above all, two Chinese characters can be noticed, which say "choices"
entries.en: To begin with, {汉字数量} Chinese characters can be noticed, which say "{文字说明内容}".
entries.zh: 首先，{汉字数量}个汉字能被注意到，其内容是：{文字说明内容}。
notes: 表达技巧 · 数字准确：用 two Chinese characters 而非模糊的 several，能数清就写准确数字

entries.origin: 13 年英语一：选择 · 首段倒装描述句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·倒装描述句（方位倒装）
entries.originalText: Then, let us closely observe the draying. In front of many options stand a host of graduates, staring/looking at four directions: creating their ow businesses/firms/companies, going abroad, preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies, and hunting for jobs.
entries.en: Then, let us closely observe the drawing. In front of {环境} stand a host of {主体群体}, staring at {选项数量} directions: {选项一}, {选项二}, {选项三}, and {选项四}.
entries.zh: 然后，让我们细致观察一下漫画。在{环境}的前方站着很多{主体群体}，盯着前面的{选项数量}个方向：{选项一}、{选项二}、{选项三}、{选项四}。
notes: 语法点：In front of + 地点 + stand + 主语，方位状语置于句首引起完全倒装
表达技巧 · 替代表达：不会写「岔路口」可用 multiple choices 替代
原文 draying、ow 为笔记笔误，应为 drawing、own

entries.origin: 13 年英语一：选择 · 首段让步迷茫句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·让步迷茫句（with 表情）
entries.originalText: Although they have diverse choices, these youngsters do not know how to choose, with tremendous confusion on their faces.
entries.en: Although they have diverse {选择对象}, these {主体群体} do not know how to choose, with tremendous confusion on their faces.
entries.zh: 尽管他们有多个{选择对象}，但这些{主体群体}却不知道怎么选，脸上带着巨大迷茫。
notes: 情感状态词汇：迷茫 confusion/puzzlement；犹豫 hesitate

entries.origin: 13 年英语一：选择 · 第二段联系现实句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·联系现实句（显然型）
entries.originalText: Such a scenario above, apparently, can be associated with a great many/a sea of confused college students in reality.
entries.en: Such a scenario above, apparently, can be associated with a great many {现实对应群体} in reality.
entries.zh: 这样的场景，显然，能被联系到现实中很多{现实对应群体}。
notes: a sea of 意为「大量的」，是 many 的高级替换

entries.origin: 13 年英语一：选择 · 第二段现象描述句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象描述句（时点迷茫型）
entries.originalText: Admittedly/Definitely, now, an increasing number of youngsters become bewildered/puzzled when they will graduate.
entries.en: Admittedly, now, an increasing number of {现实群体} become bewildered when {发生时点}.
entries.zh: 不得不承认，如今，越来越多{现实群体}在{发生时点}时变得迷茫。

entries.origin: 13 年英语一：选择 · 第二段机构失职评价句
entries.section: 图画作文第二段·现象评价句（机构失职型）
entries.originalText: This phenomenon is particularly worth concerning for the reason that universities/colleges may pay excessive attention to students' academic pursuit/performance, ignoring/overlooking the significance of occupational planning/vocational plan for them.
entries.en: This phenomenon is particularly worth concerning for the reason that {机构主体} may pay excessive attention to {片面关注对象}, ignoring the significance of {被忽略的重要事物}.
entries.zh: 这种现象是非常值得关注的，因为{机构主体}只关注{片面关注对象}，忽略了{被忽略的重要事物}的重要性。
notes: pay excessive attention to 表「过度关注」，是 focus only on 的变体
机构失职是校园类图画的常用批判角度

pageNotes: 解读误区观察要点 · 环境：岔路口/多选择场景；主体：多排毕业生站立不动；选项：创业、出国、考研、求职四个方向
表达技巧 · 数字准确：用「two Chinese characters」而非模糊的「若干」
表达技巧 · 替代表达：不会写「岔路口」可用「multiple choices」替代
表达技巧 · 动词选择：用「staring at」或「looking at」描述注视动作
实用建议：不会写的词汇可换简单表达或省略；从阅读理解题中寻找可用词汇（如 choose）

vocab.en: starting up / creating their own businesses
